description: Get one virtual machine by ID: status, specs, IP address, network, and image details. The ipAddress is the private address on the VM's network; the public IP comes from list_public_ips_by_isolated_network or list_public_ips_by_vpc for that network. To connect over SSH, log in at the public IP as the default user cloud, unless the user names a different one.

id.description: VM identifier (UUID), from list_vms or create_vm.

name: get_vm
title: Get VM
